data.name: Laylaa
data.gender_notes: Laylaa is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The most beautiful night of the year, as mentioned in the Quran. The name Laylaa carries the meaning “Night” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Laylaa usually hope their child will grow to embody night and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A symbol of patience and perseverance, as Layla is the wife of Prophet Ibrahim (AS) in the Quranic story
data.etymology: Laylaa belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Night.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Laylaa total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.

in_arabic.name: ليلى
in_arabic.meaning: ليلاء تعني ليلة جميلة و ساحرة و ليلة الحناء
in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم ليلى في اللغة العربية يعني الليلة الجميلة الساحرة، و هو مشتق من كلمة ليل، و له دلالة على جمال و سحر الليالي. و قد ورد ذكر الليالي في القرآن الكريم في سورة يوسف آية 4: "وَكَذَلِكَ مَكَّنَّا لِيُوسُفَ فِي الْأَرْضِ وَلِنُعَلِّمَهُ مِن تَفْسِيرِ الْأَحَادِيثِ وَاللَّهُ غَائِبٌ عَلَى عَرشِهِ وَهُوَ يُحْيِي الْمَوْتَى وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ مُقْتَدِرٌ"

in_urdu.name: لیلا
in_urdu.meaning: لیلا مطلب ہے خوبصورت رات، سحر انگیز رات
in_urdu.long_meaning: اردو میں لیلا نام کا مطلب ہے خوبصورت رات یا سحر انگیز رات۔ یہ نام عربی زبان سے ماخوذ ہے جہاں اس کا مطلب ہے لیل یا رات۔ یہ نام جنوب ایشیاء میں مسلمانوں کے ہاں مقبول ہے اور اکثر خوبصورتی اور سحر کے ساتھ جوڑا جاتا ہے۔

in_hindi.name: लीला
in_hindi.meaning: लीला का अर्थ है सुंदर रात, जादुई रात
in_hindi.long_meaning: हिंदी में लीला नाम का अर्थ है सुंदर रात या जादुई रात। यह नाम अरबी भाषा से लिया गया है जहां इसका अर्थ है रात। यह नाम भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में लोकप्रिय है और अक्सर सुंदरता और जादू के साथ जुड़ा होता है।

in_pashto.name: ليلى
in_pashto.meaning: ليلى د ښکلې شپې، جادوګرې شپې معنی
in_pashto.long_meaning: په پښتو کې د ليلى نوم مطلب د ښکلې شپې یا جادوګرې شپې دی. دا نوم د عربي ژبې څخه اخیستل شوی دی چیرته چې د شپې معنی لري. دا نوم په افغانستان کې د پښتنو په منځ کې مشهور دی او ډیری وختونه د ښکلې او جادو سره تړاو لري.

in_english.name: Laylaa
in_english.meaning: Beautiful night, magical night, or dark beauty
in_english.long_meaning: The name Laylaa originates from the Arabic word 'layl', meaning night. It signifies a beautiful or magical night. In Islamic tradition, the name is associated with beauty, mystery, and the enchanting qualities of the night. The name has historical significance and is used across various Muslim cultures, symbolizing the tranquility and serenity of the night.

data.cultural_impact: The name Laylaa is of Arabic origin and holds significant cultural value in Islamic tradition. It is believed to be the name of a beloved woman who is mentioned in several poems and stories throughout Arab history. The most famous of these stories is the "Tales of Layla and Majnun," a tragic love story between Layla and her beloved Qays ibn al-Mulawwah, who is also known as Majnun (the mad one). Layla's name has become synonymous with beauty and the epitome of feminine grace.
data.spiritual_significance: In the Islamic context, the name Laylaa holds a deeper spiritual significance. In the Holy Quran, there is a Surah (chapter) called Surah al-Qadr, which refers to the "Night of Decree," also known as Laylat al-Qadr. This is believed to be the night when the first verses of the Quran were revealed to Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him). Layla, as the night of divine revelation, signifies a time of spiritual transformation and enlightenment. It is a night of blessings, forgiveness, and mercy from God Almighty.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The meaning "Night" symbolizes The most beautiful night of the year, as mentioned in the Quran. In Islamic spirituality, bearing the name Laylaa serves as a constant reminder of one's spiritual aspirations and connection to Islamic values of night.

islamic_reference.note: Traditional Islamic name with deep spiritual significance in Islamic culture

historical_references.reference: Layla is mentioned in the Quran as the name of a woman in love with Majnun, who was a poet and a lover of Layla. The story of Layla and Majnun is a famous one in Islamic literature and is often told as a romantic tale.
